Message:
bnxt_en: Fix up bnxt_get_rxfh_indir_size().

Fix up bnxt_get_rxfh_indir_size() to return the proper current RSS
table size for P5 chips.  Change it to non-static so that bnxt.c
can use it to get the table size.
